narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Divide the exponents to get two to the power seven, a number ending in eight.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Dividing powers with the same base takes away the exponents.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Also, the bases are four and two, so they must match first. The slip fails.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, test a smaller case, such as two to the power eight.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Eight is a multiple of four, and two hundred fifty six also ends in six.

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu divides the exponents to get two to the power seven, a number ending in eight. Dividing powers with the same base subtracts the exponents, and four is not two.
